Strong thematic alignment: Cortech's core competencies in MEL, research and documentation, livelihoods and economic inclusion, refugee/displacement programming, and community engagement directly match tracer study requirements
Geographic strength: Cortech has established presence in Kenya (Nairobi office) with existing relationships in East Africa and refugee-affected contexts
Methodological expertise: KoboToolbox expertise, SPSS/NVivo for data analysis, participatory action research methods, and experience with vulnerable populations align perfectly with assignment needs
Client relationships: Cortech's track record with UN agencies (UNHCR, ILO, UNICEF), development partners (Save the Children, DRC), and refugee-focused organizations (Alight Somalia) demonstrates relevant credibility
Language capacity: Team proficiency in English, Somali, and Swahili supports implementation in Kenya
Experience with complex emergencies: Prior work in Somalia and displacement contexts shows ability to navigate challenging operational environments

Must be legally registered as a Kenya-based consultancy firm with valid business license - Cortech's Kenya presence may need formal domestic registration if not already established
Lead consultant must have minimum 8 years field research experience - Cortech's team profile should be verified against this specific threshold
Specific tracer study experience in refugee contexts appears underspecified in Cortech profile; need to demonstrate prior tracer or longitudinal beneficiary tracking work
Requirement for tablets/smartphones for fieldwork - Cortech must confirm access to hardware or budget provision for equipment
KRA PIN, Tax Compliance Certificate, and Certificate of Incorporation for Kenya entity - Cortech must ensure all compliance documents are current
Sample field report requirement - Cortech should prepare this as part of technical proposal
